phase: Post-Warmup T0 Spread Origin and N-Window Formation
researchQuestion: Why does T0 post-warmup spread differ by N, especially why is N=75 uniquely broad before the later entry bridge stage?
answer: The post-warmup w2->T0 handoff is the key N-window formation transform. The transform is rank-inverting. d/K at w2 near-perfectly diagnoses profile-level delta_omega (|r| > 0.92). N-window outcome is determined by w2-state distribution SPREAD (km/lambda IQR), not by mean d_w2. N=75 amplifies to bulk-wide T0 spread (1.98x); N=72 collapses (0.11x); N=70 remains stable compressed.
